# uptimekuma_notification_ooredoo (Resource)

Ooredoo Maldives bulk SMS notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_ooredoo" "example" {
  name         = "Ooredoo Notifications"
  username     = "bulk-sms-user"
  access_key   = "0123456789abcdef"
  bearer_token = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
  to_number    = "9601234567"
  is_active    = true
  is_default   = false
}

# Send to several recipients. Recipients are separated by comma, semicolon or whitespace, so an
# individual number must not contain spaces. Uptime Kuma strips every "+" character and prefixes
# bare 7 digit numbers with the Maldives country code "960".
resource "uptimekuma_notification_ooredoo" "multiple_recipients" {
  name         = "Ooredoo On-Call"
  username     = "bulk-sms-user"
  access_key   = "0123456789abcdef"
  bearer_token = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
  to_number    = "1234567,+9607654321"
  is_active    = true
  is_default   = false
}

# Use a custom API endpoint. If server_url is unset, Uptime Kuma falls back to
# "https://o-papi1-lb01.ooredoo.mv/bulk_sms/v2".
resource "uptimekuma_notification_ooredoo" "custom_endpoint" {
  name         = "Ooredoo Custom Endpoint"
  username     = "bulk-sms-user"
  access_key   = "0123456789abcdef"
  bearer_token = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
  to_number    = "9601234567"
  server_url   = "https://o-papi2-lb01.ooredoo.mv/bulk_sms/v2"
  is_active    = true
  is_default   = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: access_key_wo and bearer_token_wo
# are never stored in plan or state. Change the matching *_wo_version whenever a
# secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_ooredoo" "write_only" {
  name      = "Ooredoo with write-only secrets"
  username  = "bulk-sms-user"
  to_number = "9601234567"

  access_key_wo           = "0123456789abcdef"
  access_key_wo_version   = "1"
  bearer_token_wo         = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
  bearer_token_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `to_number` (String) One or more recipient phone numbers, separated by comma, semicolon or whitespace. Since whitespace separates recipients, an individual number must not contain spaces. Uptime Kuma strips every `+` character and prefixes bare 7 digit numbers with the Maldives country code `960`. The numbers are not validated when the notification is saved: Uptime Kuma only rejects it at send time if no recipient remains at all.
- `username` (String) The Ooredoo bulk SMS account username.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `access_key` (String, Sensitive) The Ooredoo account access key. Uptime Kuma Base64 encodes it before it is passed on to the gateway. Stored in state; use `access_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `access_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The Ooredoo account access key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `access_key`; requires `access_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `access_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `access_key` until the next apply with `access_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `access_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `access_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `access_key_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) The token authenticating the request against the gateway. It is sent as an `Authorization: Bearer` header. Stored in state; use `bearer_token_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `bearer_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The token authenticating the request against the gateway, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `bearer_token`; requires `bearer_token_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `bearer_token_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `bearer_token` until the next apply with `bearer_token_wo` set removes it from state.
- `bearer_token_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `bearer_token_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `bearer_token_wo`.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `server_url` (String) The Ooredoo API endpoint. If unset, Uptime Kuma falls back to `https://o-papi1-lb01.ooredoo.mv/bulk_sms/v2`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
